description: Resolve a place to ranked candidates with lat/lon: city ("Denver"), "city, ST", ZIP ("50219"), or partial input with fuzzy=true ("bost" -> Boston); venues and addresses where enabled. Rows carry `type` place|zip|address|poi; pass a row's lat/lon to weather tools. `matched_via: "autosuggest"` marks rows found after the exact match missed; `partial` means a section timed out. Weather tools take `location` directly, venues included -- use this to disambiguate ("which Springfield?") or present choices.

fuzzy.description: Autosuggest mode for partial/misspelled input. Default false (exact search).

near_lat.description: Rank venues/addresses near this point; pair with near_lon.

query.description: Place query: city, "city, state", ZIP, partial text, or venue/address where enabled.

name: search_locations

matched_via.description: Set on exact-search rows found by the venue/address fallback.

partial.description: Sections that did not finish, e.g. {"poi": "timeout"}; the list may be incomplete.

title: Search locations
